summary: Nuvectis Pharma filed an 8-K to disclose a license agreement with Haisco Pharmaceutical Group for exclusive rights to develop and commercialize two drug candidates (NXP100 and NXP200) in specified territories. Terms include a $20 million upfront payment, up to $20 million in early milestones, up to $1.4 billion in contingent milestones, and tiered high-single-digit to mid-teens royalties. The agreement is subject to financing conditions. This is an in-licensing transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
